title: Trump's SI Rebrand Results in Flurry of .SI Domain Registrations
key_facts: PCMag says President Trump has rebranded AI as 'Super Intelligence' (SI), and says the rebrand has no basis in any technological development.
Slovenia's .si domain suffix saw a flurry of registrations of AI-related names.
Independent journalist Adam Cochran alleged insiders profited by registering .si names before Trump's Truth Social posts; he cited more than 10,000 AI-related terms registered in recent months.
The White House and Register.Si, Slovenia's registrar, deny wrongdoing, Snopes reports; no link between Trump's circle and the purchases is shown.
AI.si is on sale for at least $700,000 and TechCrunch reports some names sold for over $1 million.
Money from the sales goes to the registrar, not the Slovenian state.
Elon Musk says he will rename SpaceXAI to SpaceXSI.
Trump said calling it artificial makes intelligence sound fake, the AP reports.
quote_evidence: The White House and Register.Si, Slovenia's registrar, denies any wrongdoing, Snopes reports.
Trump and those in his orbit have also not been tied directly to .si domain purchases
Unfortunately for Slovenia, the home country of First Lady Melania Trump, money raised from the domain purchases goes to the registrar, not the country's treasury.
why_it_matters_hint: A political rebrand set off a domain land rush, with an unproven insider-profit allegation denied by those named.
event_date: Rebrand announced about a week before 6 Oct 2026 (exact date not given in the text); domain registrations 53 days ago onward
notes: Rebrand date not stated, so freshness set NEW for the PCMag report of 6 Oct; score lowered 1 because the allegation is unproven and the underlying rebrand is older. Funny detail confirmed in text.
